R package · Menopausal hormone therapy

MHT exposure from Swedish prescription data.

Categorise dispensed menopausal hormone therapy products, correct the durations that the register records unreliably, bridge the gaps between consecutive prescriptions, and write the approach-based exposure definitions onto a person-week skeleton.

Get started Browse the reference →

What’s inside

01

Product-name categorisation

Around 110 Swedish menopausal hormone therapy product names are mapped onto the A1–I2 category ladder: local and systemic estrogens, combined preparations, progestogens, implants, intrauterine systems, tibolone and testosterone.

02

Duration correction and gap bridging

Dispensed durations are corrected for the products whose recorded defined daily dose is unreliable, intrauterine systems are given their real service life, and gaps of up to four weeks between consecutive prescriptions are bridged.

03

Approach-based exposure definitions

The rd_approach{1,2,3,3b}_{single,multiple} variables are written onto a person-week skeleton, applying the previous and exclude rules and the three-year minimum-duration rule used by the Skalkidou-lab MHT studies.
